title: C router.c: IPv6-in-IPv6 egress decapsulation + inner-dst verify (Zephyr path)
description: Child of b7z9.4 (spec 05-routing 8.9). C lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/router.c parse_ipv6_dispatch/route_packet has no IPv6-in-IPv6 handling: next-header 41 currently falls into the EPROTONOSUPPORT reject in the extension-chain walk (router.c:369-373 rejects non-HBH/DEST_OPT/ROUTING). Add egress decap per R-05-063: accept NH=41 after SRH processing, validate inner header, verify inner dst == node's authorized 02xx, surface the inner packet to the caller for re-dispatch. Mirror the Rust child's semantics (fail-closed, bounded profile: inner chain re-validated). Files: lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/router.c + tests/routing_dispatch. Independent of Rust children; can land in either order.
close_reason: Re-close (3rd attempt; store reversion per biod). Fix intact: 992c333acd.
